notes: "Every slide has two numbers, and they mean different things. The Slide ID, here R014 and C014, is assigned once and never changes: rename the slide, move it to another Section, reorder the deck, and it is still R014. That is what you quote to a colleague or an agent. Position is just where the slide currently sits in this collection; it is computed, not stored in the slide. A page-number footer can bind to the live Position, so adding a slide does not force edits to every page after it."

designIntent.purpose: Distinguish permanent Slide ID from derived Position, with real Browse evidence.
